outputs.explanation: This is a diagrammatic bar representation illustrating the proportion of illumination overhead versus camera exposure time for five discrete exposure-time settings, each shown as a single computed percentage rather than a mean of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
Line plot of photobleaching decay curves with shaded mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
A scatter/line plot of ΔROS versus exposure time with error bars and a fitted trend line; scatter plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Migration track line plots; each line already represents an individual cell's trajectory, and line plots are exempt from the requirement.
Bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed with individual cell data points (black dots) overlaid on each bar.
